mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.actor_name, f.remark, f.created_at, s.id AS star_id, s.avatar AS avatar, s.avatar_local AS avatar_local FROM javbus_follow_actor f LEFT JOIN javbus_star s ON s.id = (SELECT MIN(s2.id) FROM javbus_star s2 WHERE s2.name = f.actor_name) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO javbus_follow_actor (actor_name, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{actorName}, #{remark}, NOW())
